verification_note: Checked 2026-11-21 through web search results; the organizations' own pages were not fetched directly from the research sandbox. 'verified' means a result from the organization's own domain confirmed it exists and its official URL; 'partially_verified' means only directories, news, or other secondary sources did. Programs, dates, eligibility and contact routes must be read on the official page before any outreach. Contact details are deliberately not stored here.
fit_scale: Fit for a cyber and AI-risk advisory selling to Burlington and Halton small and mid-sized organizations: high = the audience is business owners and the leverage is earned (workshop, listing, editorial); low = consumer audience or paid placement only.

geographies.neighbourhood_note: Neighbourhood names are planning labels only; they were not re-verified and must not be used as page targets.

guardrails: Read the program, date, eligibility rule and contact route on the official page before any outreach or publication.
Pursue editorial, membership, workshop or partnership value; never pay for an undisclosed link and never use directory spam.
Sponsorships are paid placements: disclose them and do not count them as earned mentions.
Every outreach message needs named human approval and a CASL check before it is sent.
